analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring the functionality is preserved and enhanced with modern practices.
requirements_understanding: The legacy application is a VB6 banking system with forms for various banking operations.
The modernization involves translating the application to C#, documenting functionality, and ensuring it meets security and quality standards.
The application should be deployable in a Docker environment for testing.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Translate VB6 forms and logic to C# using modern frameworks.
Implement a microservices architecture to replace monolithic structures.
Ensure the application is containerized for Docker deployment.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific performance benchmarks that the modernized application must meet?
What are the specific security standards to be adhered to during modernization?

output.executive_summary: The project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is preserved and enhanced with modern practices, including deployment in a Docker environment.

functional_requirements.title: Login Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Implement secure login functionality in C# equivalent to the legacy VB6 system.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in using their existing credentials.
Login attempts are logged for security auditing.
Failed login attempts trigger a security alert after three unsuccessful tries.

functional_requirements.title: Customer Management
functional_requirements.description: Develop customer management features in C# to handle customer data operations.
acceptance_criteria: CRUD operations for customer data are functional and secure.
Data validation is enforced according to business rules.
Changes to customer data are logged for audit purposes.

functional_requirements.title: Transaction Processing
functional_requirements.description: Implement transaction processing capabilities in C# for deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.
acceptance_criteria: Transactions are processed accurately and logged.
Concurrency control ensures data consistency during transactions.
Transaction failures trigger rollback and alert mechanisms.

functional_requirements.title: Account Type Management
functional_requirements.description: Provide functionality to manage different account types in the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create, update, and delete account types.
Account type changes are reflected in customer accounts.
Audit trails are maintained for all account type modifications.

functional_requirements.title: Reporting
functional_requirements.description: Develop reporting features in C# to replace the legacy VB6 reporting capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Reports can be generated for transactions, customer data, and account summaries.
Reports are exportable in PDF and Excel formats.
Access to reports is restricted based on user roles.

functional_requirements.title: Data Environment Configuration
functional_requirements.description: Recreate the data environment configuration in C# to ensure seamless database interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Database connections are established using secure protocols.
Data access is optimized for performance.
Configuration changes are logged and auditable.

functional_requirements.title: Docker Deployment
functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application is deployable in a Docker environment for local testing.
acceptance_criteria: Application can be built and run in a Docker container.
Docker images are optimized for size and performance.
Deployment scripts are provided for automated setup.

functional_requirements.title: Security Enhancements

acceptance_criteria: Data encryption is applied to sensitive information.

Security vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated.

phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

in_scope: Preserve legacy business behavior and workflows

items.title: Login Functionality
items.outcome: Implement secure login functionality in C# equivalent to the legacy VB6 system.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in using their existing credentials.
Login attempts are logged for security auditing.
Failed login attempts trigger a security alert after three unsuccessful tries.

items.title: Customer Management
items.outcome: Develop customer management features in C# to handle customer data operations.
acceptance_criteria: CRUD operations for customer data are functional and secure.
Data validation is enforced according to business rules.
Changes to customer data are logged for audit purposes.

items.title: Transaction Processing
items.outcome: Implement transaction processing capabilities in C# for deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.
acceptance_criteria: Transactions are processed accurately and logged.
Concurrency control ensures data consistency during transactions.
Transaction failures trigger rollback and alert mechanisms.

items.title: Account Type Management
items.outcome: Provide functionality to manage different account types in the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create, update, and delete account types.
Account type changes are reflected in customer accounts.
Audit trails are maintained for all account type modifications.

items.title: Reporting
items.outcome: Develop reporting features in C# to replace the legacy VB6 reporting capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Reports can be generated for transactions, customer data, and account summaries.
Reports are exportable in PDF and Excel formats.
Access to reports is restricted based on user roles.

items.title: Data Environment Configuration
items.outcome: Recreate the data environment configuration in C# to ensure seamless database interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Database connections are established using secure protocols.
Data access is optimized for performance.
Configuration changes are logged and auditable.

items.title: Docker Deployment
items.outcome: Ensure the application is deployable in a Docker environment for local testing.
acceptance_criteria: Application can be built and run in a Docker container.
Docker images are optimized for size and performance.
Deployment scripts are provided for automated setup.

items.title: Security Enhancements
items.outcome: Implement security enhancements in the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: Data encryption is applied to sensitive information.
User roles and permissions are enforced.
Security vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated.

items.title: Performance
items.outcome: Ensure the application meets performance benchmarks for response time and throughput.
acceptance_criteria: Application response time is consistently below 200ms for 95% of requests.
Load testing shows the application can handle 1000 concurrent users.
Performance metrics are logged and monitored.

items.title: Security
items.outcome: Implement security measures to protect against common vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show no critical vulnerabilities.
User data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Access logs are maintained and reviewed regularly.

items.title: Scalability
items.outcome: Design the application to scale with increased load and data volume.
acceptance_criteria: Application can scale horizontally to support increased load.
Database performance remains stable under increased data volume.
Scalability tests demonstrate system resilience.

items.title: Reliability
items.outcome: Ensure the application is reliable and available with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Application uptime is maintained at 99.9% or higher.
Automated monitoring detects and alerts on failures.
Failover mechanisms are in place for critical components.

items.title: Usability

acceptance_criteria: User interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.

User feedback indicates high satisfaction with the interface.
